post.description: Public sign-up of a field worker; a manager approves it before it can work.

get.description: The companies a worker can choose from when signing up; name only, never the CNPJ.

schema.title: Response List Public Companies Public Contractor Companies Get

get.description: The notice a worker accepts when signing up; its version goes back in the sign-up.

RF27 "rota do dia": the signed-in worker's route of today (or none yet). Same `RouteOut`
shape the manager endpoints return, so mobile and the dashboard render a route identically.

post.description:
The "Iniciar rota" button: create or reopen today's route and hand out a batch; a retry
while the batch is open returns it unchanged. A route DONE for an empty pool is looked at
again: reopened with the points released since, else `pool_empty=true`. 409 with a machine
code when the day or the position refuses any batch.

The next batch once the current one has no open stop (unchanged while it has one). An
empty pool closes the route: `pool_empty=true`, status DONE; asking again the same workday
reopens it when a point went back to the pool. 409 `ROUTE_DONE` for a route of a past
day.

Response List Contractor Companies Contractor Companies Get

delete.description:
Removes the building with its floors, QR codes, points and their history — decided by
the product owner (spec 2026-10-20-predios-pontos-dialogs-design.md §3.4).

schema.title: Response List Service Points Service Points Get

delete.description:
Removes the point and its history (route stops, executions, photos) — decided by the
product owner (spec 2026-10-20-predios-pontos-dialogs-design.md §3.4).

post.description:
RF16-RF17 — the field worker signals they cannot execute this stop (scope=STOP) or the
rest of the route (scope=ROUTE_REMAINDER); what it covers goes back to the pool and the
managers are alerted and notified. The report, and the released stops' `release_reason`,
are the record — no audit-trail entry is appended here.

get.description:
The manager's Justificativas tab (spec §8.4): every impediment, PENDING first, or only
those of `?status=`.

post.description: The manager's "ciente": PENDING → RESOLVED, audited. Idempotent on a RESOLVED one.

get.description:
The app's "Pontos liberados que você pode contestar": the worker's released stops they
may still appeal, latest release first.

schema.title: Response List Appealable Stops Appeals Eligible Get

post.description:
The worker declares they executed a released stop (spec §7.5). Idempotent on
`idempotency_key`; 409 `NOT_APPEALABLE` with a `reason_code` when it is not theirs to
appeal now.

get.description:
The manager's Justificativas "Recursos" tab (spec §8.4): every appeal, PENDING first, or
only those of `?status=`.
The worker's own appeals and their decisions, pending first.

schema.title: Response List My Appeals Appeals Mine Get

post.description:
Accept: the stop gets an `APPEAL` execution by the worker. 409 `ALREADY_REVIEWED` once
decided.
Reject: nothing changes besides the record. 409 `ALREADY_REVIEWED` once decided.

get.description:
RF41 — the board of the day: per-type pool KPIs, today's routes with their current
batch and OPEN alert count, who has not started, today's releases, the board's alert list,
and the latest GPS fix per worker.

RF41 real-time — the same `BoardSnapshot` as `GET /monitoring/board`, pushed as
Server-Sent Events whenever its meaningful content changes (spec §2 Ruling 4, §4).
RF41 — the dashboard's alert list, optionally filtered by `status` and/or `route_id`.

post.description:
Cenário 5 step 7 — a manager takes an OPEN alert. Idempotent on an already
ACKNOWLEDGED alert; a RESOLVED alert answers 409.

Cenário 5 step 8 — a manager closes an alert from OPEN or ACKNOWLEDGED (idempotent
on an already RESOLVED alert).

schema.title: Response Get Alert Rules Alert Rules Get

patch.description:
Toggle a rule on/off or override its threshold (RF50). An unknown `rule_kind` answers
404 (the path is a free string, not the path enum, so the check is ours to make).

post.description:
Mark one notification read. 404 when it does not exist, 403 when it is not the
caller's — a user can only touch their own centre.

get.description:
RF45 — the compliance read model as JSON: the granularity buckets with the point-day
indicators plus `completion_rate`, a totals row, and the resolved `filters_applied`.
RF46 — the same report rendered as a printable landscape-A4 PDF attachment.
RF46 — the same report as an XLSX workbook attachment.

AllocationBody.title: AllocationBody
AllocationBody.description:
Where the worker is when asking for a batch: the nearest free points are measured from
here, and it must be inside the campus.

ComplianceReportOut.title: ComplianceReportOut
ComplianceReportOut.description:
Mirror of `ComplianceReport`. The domain builder already returns frozen, JSON-serialisable
dataclasses; this thin `...Out` layer (built via `model_validate`, `from_attributes=True`)
keeps the API schema explicit and decoupled from the dataclass without restating the query
or re-deriving anything.

ComplianceRowOut.title: ComplianceRowOut
ComplianceRowOut.description: Mirror of `ComplianceRow` — one granularity bucket: its identity plus the indicators.

ComplianceTotalsOut.title: ComplianceTotalsOut
ComplianceTotalsOut.description:
Mirror of `ComplianceCounts` — the point-day indicators (spec 2026-10-20-alocacao-
automatica §8.7), the linked executions and alerts, and the derived `completion_rate`.
`points_done` includes the ones done by appeal; `points_impeded` is the release counter of
the IMPEDIMENT reason.

DeletionImpactOut.title: DeletionImpactOut
DeletionImpactOut.description: What a removal takes with it — shown before the manager confirms.

EmbeddedForm.title: EmbeddedForm
EmbeddedForm.description:
The stop's active PUBLISHED execution form, shipped inside `GET /routes/me` so the app
has the schema (with hashes) before it goes offline (spec §5.2, Etapa 7).

FilterAppliedOut.title: FilterAppliedOut
FilterAppliedOut.description:
Mirror of `app.domain.reports.compliance.FilterApplied` — the human-readable echo of the
filters that were applied, with UUIDs already resolved to names by the builder.

FormQuestionField.title: FormQuestionField
FormQuestionField.description:
One question of the embedded form, mirroring `FormQuestionOut`. `content_hash` is the
per-question fingerprint the app pins each answer to while offline (spec §5.2).

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Liveness payload consumed by Docker healthchecks and by CI smoke steps.

MyDayOut.title: MyDayOut
MyDayOut.description:
The worker's day for the app: today's route, if any, and the location-silence limits it
warns the worker about (spec §7.3).

PoolKpi.title: PoolKpi
PoolKpi.description:
Today's typed points of one service type: `done` (served, also by appeal) + `in_progress`
(in somebody's batch) + `free` (in the pool) = `total`.

ServiceTypeRow.title: ServiceTypeRow
ServiceTypeRow.description: One line of the company dialog: a type to keep (`id` set) or to create (`id` empty).
